content.value_statement: Instagram Reels often fail because hooks, captions, and send prompts target the wrong signals. This skill helps plan, script, test, and diagnose Reels using platform-specific guidance.
actual_capabilities: Creates Reels scripts with timed beats, on-screen text, audio notes, and a send-prompt CTA.
Reviews hooks against first-frame, sound-off, payoff, and shareability criteria.
Decides when to use Trial Reels based on goals, account size, and time sensitivity.
Diagnoses weak performance using skip rate, share rate, follows, retention, and post-watch behavior.
Drafts captions with keyword-first phrasing, restrained hashtags, and clear send prompts.
Checks originality, watermark, and account-type audio risks before publishing.
limitations: It cannot guarantee virality or predict exact reach.
It does not access live Instagram accounts, Insights, drafts, or private metrics.
Platform rules change, so current Instagram behavior should be verified for major campaigns.
It provides practical audio guidance, not legal advice for music licensing.

use_cases.title: Script a Cold-Reach Reel
use_cases.description: A solo creator turns a topic into a 15 to 30 second Reel with hook, beats, caption, and send prompt.

use_cases.title: Repair a Weak Hook
use_cases.description: A social media manager checks the first three seconds and rewrites the opening for sound-off viewers.

use_cases.title: Read Trial Results
use_cases.description: A small business owner compares a Trial Reel to past tests and decides whether to publish, recut, or stop.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Reel Script
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 20 second Instagram Reel script for [topic]. Include a spoken hook, on-screen text, timed beats, caption, and send-prompt CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Improve My Hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Reels hook: [hook]. Explain what fails in the first three seconds. Rewrite three stronger versions for sound-off viewers.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Trial Reel
prompt_templates.prompt: Decide whether this draft should use Trial Reels: [brief]. Consider goal, follower count, account visibility, timing, and grid risk.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these Reels Insights: [metrics]. Identify the most likely failure point, then recommend a recut, caption change, or publish decision.

output_examples.input: A skincare creator asks for a Reel about niacinamide for oily skin.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a hook about a specific mistake, timed script beats, first-frame text, a caption keyword, and a send-prompt CTA.

output_examples.input: A manager shares low sends, high views, and almost no follows for a product Reel.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that topic legibility likely failed, then suggests clearer on-screen text, a stronger caption keyword, and a named-recipient CTA.

output_examples.input: A creator wants to know whether to publish a draft or test it first.
output_examples.output: The skill checks account size, cold-reach goal, timing, and uncertainty, then recommends Trial Reels or direct publishing.

best_practices: Give the topic, target viewer, account type, follower count, and goal before asking for a script.
Share skip rate, share rate, follows, and retention notes when asking for diagnosis.
Use Trial Reels for uncertain cold-reach drafts when the account is eligible.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to promise reach, follower counts, or viral performance.
Do not use recycled TikTok or CapCut exports with visible watermarks.
Do not optimize captions around large hashtag stacks instead of clear keywords.

faq.question: Can this skill guarantee a viral Reel?
faq.answer: No. It uses Reels patterns and metrics to improve odds, but it cannot predict exact reach.

faq.question: Does it need access to my Instagram account?
faq.answer: No. You provide the brief, draft, or metrics. It does not log in or read private data.

faq.question: Can it write captions?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates keyword-first captions with a clear send prompt and limited relevant hashtags.

faq.question: Can it evaluate Trial Reels?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps decide when to test, when to publish, and when to recut after a trial.

faq.question: Does it cover music licensing?
faq.answer: It explains Creator and Business account audio constraints. It does not replace legal advice for commercial music use.

faq.question: Can I use it in Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
